Nakheel, a member of Dubai Holding Real Estate, unveiles Palm Springs, a 3.8 million sq m residential masterplan adjacent to Palm Jebel Ali in southern Dubai. Planned for almost 50,000 residents, the community will bring together homes, education, healthcare, sport, and leisure facilities across 15 neighbourhoods.

Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE) announces its financial results for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, reporting revenue of US$1.4 billion, up 13.2% year-on-year. Profit before tax and exceptional items rose by 8.8% to US$370.7 million. Total assets increased to US$26.8 billion at the end of September 2026, while its owned, managed, committed and mandated fleet is projected to grow to approximately 1,300 aircraft.

Every individual has an important role in contributing to our collective advancement. The UAE will continue its journey of progress with determination and readiness, guided by a steadfast commitment to preparing for the changes and challenges of the future. The resilience of the UAE lies in our shared values, and our nation’s security and stability will forever remain at the heart of our priorities.
